commits.subject: chore(governance): define Phase 09 infrastructure and homologation
fix(infra): make HTTPS proxy readiness check internal-safe
test(governance): advance active candidate fixture to Phase 09

delivered_scope: Phase 09 canonical manifest and active candidate based on main SHA 12b519c3e8237e1ebe43c1a0253b0747e0680e07.
Coolify-oriented homologation Compose with web, worker-default, worker-integrations, Beat, release and Redis in one stack.
PostgreSQL removed from the homologation application stack and represented only by the required external DATABASE_URL contract.
No public Redis or Celery ports; only web exposes container port 8000 for Coolify proxy ingress.
Production settings used in homologation with external effects fail-closed by default.
Environment-variable contract with placeholders only; no real credentials.
Operational runbook for Coolify topology, migrations, health, backup/restore, rollback, observability and provider subgates.
Foundation CI extended to render and validate docker-compose.homologation.yml.
Governance orchestrator fixture updated for the active Phase 09 candidate.

tests.previous_ci: Foundation CI #204 failed only because the orchestrator test still expected active_candidate to be null; canonical governance validation itself passed.

ci.context: A replacement Foundation CI must validate the refreshed Phase 09 candidate before implementation is marked complete.

organization_isolation.evidence: Phase 09 introduces no new operational entity or authorization path. Existing cross-Organization tests remain mandatory in the full regression suite.

legacy_reuse.flowlog_reference: No Flowlog runtime, database, Redis, secrets or infrastructure may be reused.

deferred: real Coolify resource provisioning until separately executed/recorded in the authorized homologation environment
provider sandbox activation and credentials until provider-specific authorization
risks: The external PostgreSQL resource must be reachable privately from the Coolify application stack without exposing port 5432 publicly.
Backup must be proven by restore, not only configuration.
Production SECURE_SSL_REDIRECT requires internal healthchecks to represent the proxy HTTPS scheme.
Redis is intentionally ephemeral for the initial homologation stack; durable canonical state remains in PostgreSQL.

human_approval.evidence: Human approved the Phase 09 plan and explicitly authorized implementation. Final Phase 09 approval, production go-live, provider activation, release and Phase 10 remain pending.
